Division Exception Report

The Division Exception Report form configures parameters for tracking division issues.

Set date ranges and divisions to identify transactions with division exceptions.

From

Enter the start date for the report period.

The report will analyze division assignments from this date forward.

To

Enter the end date for the report period.

All transactions up to and including this date will be checked for division issues.

Description

Enter an optional description for this report.

This report identifies transactions that may have incorrect or missing division assignments.

It helps ensure all transactions are properly allocated to divisions for accurate divisional reporting.
